title: A file or folder of a file tree (TOOLS Addendum H)
description: A file is a document with content, its bytes as a blob reference (raw) or any JSON value (a JSON file); a folder is one without content, the folder {folder}/{name}. A document is in the tree only when its folder is / or has a folder document.

folder.description: The path of the folder holding it: / or /-separated titles.

name.description: Its title: NFC, 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8 (the byte length is the tool's to check), not . or .., without /, \, control characters, line or paragraph separators, or bidirectional controls.

content.description: The file: a blob reference for a raw file, any value for a JSON file. Absent in a folder.
